newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Trygg-Hansa says to cooperate with Danish banks.
newsitem.headline: Trygg-Hansa says to cooperate with Danish banks.

text.p: Swedish insurer Trygg-Hansa said on Monday it signed an agreement with 13 local Danish banks about sales of private non-life insurance.
"Initially, the agreement regards 13 independent banks but the intention is to involve more banks in the cooperation in the coming year," Trygg-Hansa said in a statement.
The banks -- which are members of Lokale Penninginstitutter, a common organisation for a network of local Danish banks -- will start selling the insurance policies on May 1.

"Through the cooperation Trygg-Hansa will reach more than 300,000 bank customers at the same time as banks will be able to offer their customers competitive products within the entire non-life insurance segment," it said.
"The banks will do the entire selling, including signing the insurance policy with the customer, which is a very cost efficient way of selling," Trygg-Hansa said.
